note: Ceiling for internal/controlplane, in hand-written non-test Go lines. reason: Lowered by 54 when Artifacts took a port and an application layer. The envelope rules were already this context's and moved to domain/ unchanged; what joined them is the content identity the rest of the system addresses artifacts by -- the blob descriptor, media-type defaulting and expected-digest validation -- plus the two envelope questions about Environments. ArtifactRepository became ports.BlobStore, an alias so the existing repository implementations satisfy it without knowing, and staging a Bundle's layers into that store became application/. The previous 25258 was recorded on 2026-08-15 for the Identity slice, on the same counting basis. Export pipelines stay in the facade for now and that is a scope decision rather than an oversight: ExportPipeline carries TargetHubVersions and its validation returns the facade's ValidationError, so moving it means moving two more contexts' vocabulary with it.
